requirements.capacity: Verify the real continuation controller refuses insufficient archive space before claim or custody using disposable fixtures and mocked capacity.
requirements.inert-custody: Add and run an isolated end-to-end test from real run_next(continuation=True) at committed index 8 through existing real Windows Job, inert worker, journal, custody and evidence readback. Reuse the inert shim and lawful fixture technique in tests/al02_release_rehearsal/campaign-controller-probe.py and tests/test_al02_campaign_controller.py. Keep changes within this test module. Adapt command, context and paths only inside the test. Enforce a hard prelaunch barrier that refuses the scientific worker and non-temporary attempts. Carry frozen continuation binding/package identity and committed index/seed separately from synthetic context/seed. Verify terminal custody and analyze with the existing evidence verifier. Do not use production attempt paths or run a World. Do not change frozen artifacts or rerun the completed final batch controller repair.
requirements.inert-reconciliation: After the inert-custody requirement is accepted, extend that fixture with a restart or tampered-journal refusal demonstrating the real controller and custody evidence prevent a new claim or Job launch. Retain the earlier test. Never invoke scientific worker.
requirements.journal-integrity: Extend the already accepted inert continuation fixture to test a distinct gap: tamper only a disposable partial journal after real Windows Job and custody, and verify the real evidence verifier rejects the modified journal against the original terminal pin. Preserve all accepted tests and test-only launch guards; do not run a World or modify production evidence.
requirements.launch-provenance: Exercise the prelaunch no-World barrier of the accepted inert continuation fixture with a substituted command or changed inert shim bytes. Assert refusal before Windows Job or attempt claim. Keep the lawful inert path passing and all existing acceptance intact.

continuation.testNote: Name the new tests with inert_continuation in the name. Use the existing Windows inert worker only. Do not fake custody or Job execution; fixture verification must remain honest about synthetic evidence.
